description: This file defines the GatewayProcessManager class responsible for managing an internal gateway process in the application. It handles starting, stopping, attaching to existing instances, environment checks, logging, and communication with external components related to the gateway.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the lifecycle and status of the gateway process, including starting, stopping, reattaching, environment status updates, and logging.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager.Status
classes.description: An enumeration representing the various operational states of the gateway process.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Enables or disables the gateway process based on the active parameter, managing the process lifecycle accordingly.

methods.name: ensureLaunchAgentEnabledIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically enables the launchd agent for the gateway if conditions require it.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts the gateway process if it isn't already running and conditions are met.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the gateway process and updates related state.

methods.name: clearLastFailure
methods.description: Clears the last recorded failure reason.

methods.name: refreshEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Refreshes the environment status, optionally forcing an update.

methods.name: attachExistingGatewayIfAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to attach to an existing running gateway instance; if successful, updates the status accordingly.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Creates a descriptive string for a gateway instance or health snapshot.

methods.name: describeAttachFailure
methods.description: Generates a descriptive message for an attach failure error.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines if the error is related to gateway authentication failure.

methods.name: enableLaunchdGateway
methods.description: Attempts to enable and start the gateway via launchd agent, waiting for it to become responsive.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends a string to the in-memory log buffer.

methods.name: refreshControlChannelIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the control channel connection if needed.

methods.name: waitForGatewayReady
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for the gateway to become ready within a specified timeout.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the in-memory log and deletes the log file.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Retrieves the current project root path.
